principle: One Source candidate end-to-end; capabilities into existing boxes; no new top-level institution.

source_audit_cache.epistemic_rule: REVIEWED_NO_ADMISSION is not a permanent claim that no lawful source exists; changed evidence reopens review.

required_mechanisms: locked state transaction plus explicit CAS generation/version preconditions
file fsync + atomic replace + parent-directory fsync for POSIX crash-durability pattern
reliable_task_execution.all_task_write_canonical_freshness_rule: inspect, lease acquisition, checkpoint, failure accounting and final commit require the caller-supplied current canonical identity to match the engine-pinned accepted identity; mismatch fails closed.
reliable_task_execution.task_mutation_fencing_rule: checkpoint and failure accounting require the current lease owner, exact lease epoch and unexpired lease; a superseded worker cannot mutate checkpoint progress or consume retry budget.
commit_ordering_invariant: Full authorization decision/ref validation immediately before side effect
Existing same-payload durable receipt may be returned only after fencing passes
Atomic state+receipt write using file fsync, replace, then parent-directory fsync
reliable_task_execution.read_only_receipt_rule: Receipt retrieval is a distinct read-only operation; stale commit attempts cannot obtain commit-success by bypassing fencing.
reliable_task_execution.duplicate_candidate_rule: Candidate inspection/staging occurs inside the locked state transaction so same candidate+docs_hash converges to the same task instead of requiring the caller to resolve an avoidable write race.
reliable_task_execution.durability_claim_boundary: Evidence supports the POSIX file-fsync + atomic-replace + parent-directory-fsync crash-durability pattern; it is not an unconditional guarantee across arbitrary hardware/filesystem failure semantics.
embedded_interlocks: Owner Gate required + missing/mismatched operation-specific approval => DENY
concurrent state generation/version drift => CAS conflict
expired/old lease worker + any task mutation => DENY_OR_CONFLICT
unknown or contradictory authorization/state fact => DENY_FAIL_CLOSED

required_preconditions: policy generation and digest match accepted runtime identity
authorization not expired and not future-issued
exact operation-specific Owner Gate reference present where required

required_faults: expired old-worker revival after newer lease takeover
stale canonical identity on lease/checkpoint/failure write
state committed then ACK lost / same-payload retry
same idempotency key with conflicting payload
implementation Owner Gate is not reused as runtime operation permission
parent-directory fsync path invoked after atomic replace
